dimensions: ability to remove deterministic model work

A_raw_control_plus_hardened_IO.summary: general agent -> Python/openpyxl -> reliable writer/recalc/diff; no IR, no query interface unless agent builds its own

tradeoffs.semantic_freedom: maximal; Python surface unchanged (covers 115/115 mutating scripts incl. zip/xml, styles, charts)
tradeoffs.capability_risk: lowest; nothing new to learn or adopt
tradeoffs.exploit_substrate: weak; substrate helps only via faster reads the agent chooses to use
tradeoffs.remove_deterministic_work: weak; inspection loops and fills stay stochastic

B_structured_mutation_thin_waist.summary: agent does free analysis, emits declarative edit intent; deterministic runtime validates/writes

tradeoffs.semantic_freedom: REDUCED: 25/115 mutating scripts need richer semantics (styles, xml, struct ops, conditional targets); programmatic formula construction (68 scripts) must fit fill/declarative forms or expand awkwardly
tradeoffs.compatibility: poor until learned; adoption precedent is bad (calc_translate_fill 0 invocations despite explanation; agents preferred Python after considering it)
tradeoffs.capability_risk: HIGHEST: forcing a new mutation language on the capability path; wrong-canonical propagation untested; 08_04-style agent propagation currently works in Python
tradeoffs.remove_deterministic_work: high IF adopted (fills, validation, diffs leave the model)
tradeoffs.deployability: needs agent training/prompting; forced-vs-optional is the open wound

C_compiled_query_plus_structured_mutatio.summary: current proposal: B plus optional deterministic structural queries over L0

tradeoffs.semantic_freedom: same reduction as B on the write path; read path unaffected (optional)
tradeoffs.compatibility: same write-path concern as B; read-path adoption measured weak (5/13 query use; 0/8 fill use)
tradeoffs.capability_risk: same as B plus query-maintenance risk; queries never harmed scores but never helped them either (forced-05_01 identical miss; QUERIED_BUT_WRONG_MODEL_CHOICE cases)
tradeoffs.remove_deterministic_work: highest IF both adopted (inspection queries + fill lowering)
tradeoffs.deployability: incremental (queries optional first, IR later) but two adoption gambles stacked
tradeoffs.efficiency_opportunity: highest ceiling, lowest demonstrated (all query efficiency evidence UNTESTED; translation efficiency exact-only in old arch)
transfers_cleanly: all of B plus fingerprints/temporal/graph as L1 queries
becomes_unnecessary: model-facing SQL religion; working-set protocol; grounding stage

D_transparent_interception.summary: agent writes familiar Python; sandbox captures concrete mutations into internal IR; deterministic commit (validate/recalc/diff) without a model-learned language

tradeoffs.semantic_freedom: maximal (Python remains the programming interface; census: 115/115 patterns expressible by construction)
tradeoffs.compatibility: total on the surface; new behavior only underneath (capture + receipt)
tradeoffs.capability_risk: low on the model side; risk moves to capture completeness (zip-level edits, partial failures, non-workbook side effects must be characterized, never silently dropped)
tradeoffs.exploit_substrate: medium (capture diffs against L0; verification consults L0)
tradeoffs.remove_deterministic_work: medium (validation/recalc/diff/receipt automated; fill suggestion possible as opt-in lowering of captured loop-fills)
tradeoffs.observability: high (captured intent + diff + receipt) without taxing the model
tradeoffs.mutation_safety: high (same validate-before-commit as B; plus complete capture audit)
tradeoffs.complexity: medium (sandbox wrapper, snapshot-diff, IR lowering of observed ops; strictly less model-facing surface than B/C)
tradeoffs.deployability: incremental and A/B-clean (wrap executor; compare captured-vs-actual workbooks byte-identical before any behavioral claim)
tradeoffs.efficiency_opportunity: medium (same mutation-side savings as B when captured fills are lowered; inspection-side via optional L1)
transfers_cleanly: translation (as post-capture lowering of detected loop-fills)

D_transparent_interception.assessment: technically plausible: capture = snapshot + deterministic diff of workbook bytes (openpyxl-level op log where available, byte-diff otherwise); zero-model replay of the 707-script corpus can prove capture completeness BEFORE any live test. Experimentally cleaner than B/C: one executor wrap, byte-identity gate, then capability A/B with no prompt changes.

E_no_better_design_found.summary: no fifth architecture earned by evidence; the live options are A, D, and B/C ordered by capability risk
E_no_better_design_found.note: a 'fingerprint-first planner' or 'retrieval-first agent' variant was considered and rejected: candidate-first choice is NEGATIVE (16/16 agree) and model-facing retrieval is NULL (projection discriminators); evidence does not support any design that restores semantic authority to the harness

experiments_distinguishing_architectures: H0-vs-H1 forced mutation boundary (B/C vs A/D on capability; capability gate)
interception capture-completeness replay (D feasibility; zero-model, byte-identity gate)
compiled-query efficiency replay (C's read-side claim vs agent Python loops; capability fixed)
translation/fill efficiency replay with adoption instrumentation (B/C/D mutation-side claim + why agents preferred Python)
finding-cap sensitivity on commit diagnostics (L5 value independent of architecture)
